objective: Normalize the existing greeting through one original task and native scope intent
non_goals: No new products, architecture changes, tools, configuration, documentation, or publication changes
acceptance: The existing greeting passes regression and immutable owner verification; a stopped initial native Codex Run requests source scope, Leader extends only its original task, a later native Codex generation completes, and an independent Claude reviewer evaluates the fixed candidate
architecture: ES modules using Node built-in test and assertion libraries; preserve the public greeting function
directory_outline: src/greeting.mjs is implementation; test/greeting.test.mjs is regression coverage; tools/verify-acceptance.mjs is immutable owner verification
